description: Stimulating the ventromedial nucleus of the nonspecific thalamus woke mice from NREM sleep and from anesthesia and caused high-frequency EEG activation (Honjoh et al. 2018, as reported by Aru et al.).
limitations: Reported secondhand in Aru et al. 2019. The original study is not read here, and it is not from the originators’ laboratory.

sources.quote: stimulation of the NSP ventromedial (VM) thalamic nucleus awoke mice from NREM sleep and anesthesia
